text: single-line plain text without line breaks or formatting
textarea: multi-line text with line breaks for paragraphs. Markdown formatting is allowed if content requires it.
slug: a URL-friendly slug (lowercase, hyphens, no spaces or special characters)
url: a valid URL starting with http:// or https://
password: a secure password (not for actual use)
tel: a telephone number in appropriate format for the context
writer:
text wrapped in paragraph

tags (can contain one or multiple paragraphs). Inline formatting (bold, italic, underline, code, links, email, sub, sup) is allowed.
inlineWriter:
text with inline formatting only (bold, italic, underline, code, links, email, sub, sup). NO wrapping paragraph

tags allowed.
list: HTML list wrapped in <ul> or <ol>. Use <li> for items with inline formatting (bold, italic, underline, code, links, email, sub, sup).
boundedNumber: a numeric value within the defined range
predefinedSingleSelection: single selection value based on the predefined options
predefinedMultipleSelection: one or many values based on the predefined options
dateWithTime: a date with time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format (ISO 8601)
time: a time in HH:MM:SS format (24-hour, ISO 8601)
color: a color value in hex, rgb or hsl format
link: a link: internal page UUIDs (page://...), external URLs (https://...), email links (mailto:...), or anchors (#section)
structure: repeatable structured data based on expected content structure
structureWithFields: repeatable structured data, each containing the defined sub-fields with appropriate content
object: object data based on expected content structure
objectWithFields: structured data containing the defined sub-fields with appropriate content
layout: Kirby layout with columns and blocks
boundedEntries: multiple entries of {type} values within the defined count range
